alert.note: feet pinned flat (the clip shuffles the left foot during its look-round), the stance 20% narrower

crouchwalk.note: steps 32% shorter than the source (the slowest, quietest gait: shorter steps than the sneak)

sneak.note: the crouch walk with the hips raised and shorter steps: a half-crouched tactical walk (Sneaky_Walk read as a cartoon tiptoe)

ladder.note: starts half a cycle in, where ladder_on ends; ladder_off follows a whole number of cycles + 0.5 (phase 0 of the source loop); the gripping hands held on rungs one hand step (rise / 2) apart

hang.note: hands: LEDGE.y - LEDGE.grip in index.html; the last, nearly settled 0.27 s of the clip (the body sinks 5 cm as the arms straighten), slowed to 1 s each way and eased at both turns

roll.note: the knees tucked toward the chest while he goes over (0.45-0.97 s), the arms swung out of the coat
